name: blender_viewport_capture
description: 捕获 Blender 视口截图用于 AI 分析。支持 OpenGL 渲染截图和渲染预览截图。 Use when AI needs to: (1) take a screenshot of the current viewport, (2) analyze scene composition visually, (3) capture rendered preview for AI feedback. NOT for: final production rendering, animation rendering. Blender only (run_python).
author: ArtClaw
